title: Nagarakretagama (Desyawarnana)
summary: Completed in 1365 and written in Old Javanese by Prapanca, the Nagarakretagama, properly named Desyawarnana, is a verse eulogy of King Hayam Wuruk of Majapahit. It describes his journey through the realm and lists regions under Majapahit's influence. UNESCO placed it on the Memory of the World Register in 2013.

uncertainty.note: Dated in the poem itself to Saka year 1287; Aoyama places its composition in September 1365 or later that year.
